# iSwiG switching value and dense nuclear gradient, DROP cavity
#
# Committed reference for `moist_cavity_drop_gaussian`, produced by the
# hand-written implementation at commit bb46e22 -- i.e. *before* the sparse
# rewrite and the sympy-generated pair kernel. It is what pins the rewrite to
# the pre-existing mathematics.
#
# Record layout, one per line:
#
#     path case probe quantity atom axis value
#
#   * path      `adj` sorted adjacency list, `fbk` the adj_list%n == 0 fallback
#   * case      index into `get_test_structures(mols, n_iswig_structures)`
#   * probe     index into `iswig_probes`; probes straddle the owner/neighbour
#               sphere-intersection circle, where the switch is not saturated
#   * quantity  `f0` value (atom and axis are 0), `f1` nuclear gradient entry
#   * atom      user-space atom index
#   * value     `es24.16`, an exact IEEE-754 double round trip
#
# Compared with `rel_deviation`, not bitwise: `erf` is libm and differs in the
# last bit between glibc, Apple libm and Intel.
#
# This file is committed data and the test suite deliberately cannot write it.
# If the switching definition legitimately changes, regenerate it from a
# throwaway patch and review the numerical diff before committing.
